mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions, increasing wage pressures and corporate labor costs, which leads to reduced profit margins and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the average 20d return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts above 1950 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence and rising residential investment, which precedes higher consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 20d returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy regime, increasing discount rates and reducing present value of future equity cash flows, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in the unemployment rate signals a contraction in manufacturing output and labor demand, indicating an emerging economic slowdown that triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in more than 60% of joint decline instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 365,000 million dollars, combined with rising housing starts, signals strong aggregate demand growth, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 20d returns in more than 60% of joint-triggered instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative or non-significant coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payroll growth exceeding 200,000 jobs in a single month, combined with a stable unemployment rate, indicates strong labor demand and potential wage inflation, which triggers Federal Reserve hawkish expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 200000 and UNRATE stable, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% per year, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals persistent inflationary pressures that increase the likelihood of future rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS stable, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 1.5% annualized growth, combined with rising unemployment, signals a weakening economy, which triggers risk-off behavior and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 1.5 and UNRATE rising, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).
